scope: Post-run check of responses approved for return, not proof that every response was fully read or used by the solver.
method: Independent 8kHz, 250–3700Hz bandpass; two-second reference windows every 0.5 second, all sample-level response offsets; abs correlation >=0.90 flagged for review. Gateway used different 16kHz templates.
limits: Known recording XC238544 only; no speed/pitch search.
Images and unknown derivative sources are outside this waveform check.
Gateway logs its return decision before writing the client body; tool outputs are needed to prove client receipt.
